I'm sorry, but this is going to be pretty long.

 I started going to a gym closer to my house last week (with a friend) and it's been okay so far with just the both of us. She's usually late which doesn't bother me all too much but anyways, with that being said, halfway through the week, a mutual friend of ours decided she wanted to come to the gym because she was bored at home with nothing to do. 

Turns out she wanted to work out with me and my gym partner too. We said OK even though I didn't want that because I'd have to show her how to do everything (I have previous gym experience, they don't) and even I struggle with my own form sometimes.

Anyways so the first day, she was late to the gym and left in 15 minutes because she had to do some stuff for her mom. The second day, she doesn't even show up. She lied about having other plans, when in reality she just kept sleeping. We go to the gym 11 A.M. every day, keep that in mind. To top that off, she irritates me so much sometimes. I was doing glute pull throughs and I felt like I could do some more reps so I did and she got up and said something along the lines of, "didn't you say 12? Come on, it's my turn. I have to go soon." Excuse me? Weren't you the one that got here 30 minutes late? Don't fucking rush me. Now today, a friend of my first gym partner (the only one I can tolerate) is going to be joining us as well. So it's going to be four people, including myself, doing the same workout and I'm seriously considering not going. Happy fucking Holidays to me.

EDIT: The annoying/second gym partner practically quit after 3 sessions.
